Run this first, from the repo root:  pnpm run sim:run-requests

That picks up 2026-08-19-post-merge-verification (preflight, proofs-full, evidence, in that order). Stop and report if preflight fails — a proof failure stacked on a broken preflight is not independently interpretable.

What is new and therefore what this run is actually testing: five gates that did not exist when you last ran anything. check-memory-freshness, check-action-pinning, check-org-roster, check-cited-commands, and a rewired check-assist-conformance. Two of them shell out to git ls-files through execFileSync (argv form, not a shell string), so bash 3.2 should not bite — but that is a prediction this run converts into a fact.
Also landed: the SBOM job split so third-party install scripts no longer share an environment with a push-capable token, and a rebuilt Playwright install step after it hung CI for 16 minutes.

Results committed from a legacy clone carry provenance from a repository nobody maintains.
